title: Filter Months Kept Back After Declined Refills — PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rule.** Under the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, months are kept back from a coverage-billed disposable-filter (A7038) line for filters the patient still holds; the months kept back come off the months the line covers, never taking the months shipped below zero:

- **two months** when the enrollment shows two or more refill declines dated less than two whole months before the ship date;
- **one month** when it shows exactly one such decline and that decline is dated on or before the confirmation date and no more than 30 days before it;
- otherwise none.

## Terms

- **A refill decline:** a refill contact recorded as declined on the enrollment (the patient declined a refill or reported supplies not yet used up).
- **Dated less than two whole months before the ship date:** fewer than 2 whole calendar months from the decline's contact date to the ship date.
- **The confirmation date:** the contact date of the enrollment's latest refill confirmation.

## Truth table

| Declines dated less than two whole months before the ship date | That one decline: on or before the confirmation date and no more than 30 days before it | Months kept back |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | — | 2 |
| exactly 1 | yes | 1 |
| exactly 1 | no | 0 |
| none | — | 0 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- One decline on 1 April, refill confirmed 1 May (30 days later), ship date 10 May: within two whole months and 30 days before the confirmation — one month kept back.
- One decline on 31 March, refill confirmed 1 May (31 days later): more than 30 days before the confirmation — nothing kept back.
- One decline on 3 May, refill confirmed 1 May: dated after the confirmation — nothing kept back.
- Declines on 20 March and 15 April, ship date 10 May: both fewer than two whole months before the ship date — two months kept back.
